Selma Lagerlöf – presentation

SELMA LAGERLÖF, born in 1858 at Mårbacka in the province of Värmland and deceased in 1940 at the same location, became one of the most read, famous and beloved authors in of her time. Her first novel Gösta Berling's Saga 1891 was succeeded by a great authorship, with highlights such as Jerusalem (1901–1902), The Wonderful Adventures of Nils (1906–1907) and The Emperor of Portugallia (1914). In 1909 she received The Nobel Prize in literature and she was elected to the Swedish Academy in 1914. She had readers all over the world; Nils still is a well known figure to say the least. Many of her works have turned into films of which and some, such as The Phantom Carriage by Viktor Sjöström, are legendary.
